facts.fact: BrainSAT Satellite Services was launched in South Africa on 30 June 2026 (announced by the Deputy President) and offers YahClick Ka-band satellite broadband to homes and businesses in four bundles (10, 20, 50 and 100 Gb), per BrainSAT's website; prices not given.
YahClick has been sold in South Africa for years through internet service providers such as Vox Telecom; the article gives no start date, so its published date is used.
